---
name: api-and-validation
description: Use when designing or reviewing marketplace APIs, schemas, errors, authorization, pagination, filtering, or idempotency.
---

Define input/output contracts, validation boundaries, authentication and authorization rules, error semantics, pagination/filter/sort behavior, idempotency needs, and consumer tests. Keep persistence models behind the contract. Review abuse cases and sensitive data exposure.

Quality check: invalid input, unauthorized access, not-found behavior, and partial failure are specified.
